Grouped by visit month and included visits from 2026-01-01 through 2026-11-30, excluding any visit dates after the as-of date.
Claim amount means net amount converted to SGD (claim_amt_sgd).

sql: SELECT provider_type, count(*) AS total_claims, count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_rejected) AS rejected_claims, round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_rejected) / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 2) AS rejection_rate_pct FROM claim_latest WHERE visit_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30' AND visit_date <= DATE '2026-11-30' GROUP BY provider_type ORDER BY provider_type
assumptions: Last quarter means 2026-07-01 through 2026-09-30 inclusive, applied to visit_date.
Rejection rate is rejected claims divided by all claims in that provider type for the period; rejected claims are not restricted to approved claims. A claim may be both rejected and approved.
Used claim_latest (one latest-loaded row per claim) and excluded future visit dates after 2026-11-30.
Kept Unknown provider type as a group.

sql: SELECT doctor_id, doctor_name, count(*) AS approved_claims FROM claim_latest WHERE is_approved AND visit_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30' AND visit_date <= DATE '2026-11-30' AND doctor_name <> 'Unknown' GROUP BY doctor_id, doctor_name ORDER BY approved_claims DESC, doctor_name, doctor_id LIMIT 1
assumptions: Last quarter means visit dates from 2026-07-01 through 2026-09-30, inclusive; future-dated visits are excluded.
Claims are counted from claim_latest and approved means is_approved = true.
Doctors are grouped by doctor_id, so merged duplicate doctor entries are counted as one; distinct doctors with the same name remain separate.
Unknown doctor attribution is excluded from the named-doctor ranking. Latest loaded claim versions are used, including versions loaded after the as-of date.

assumptions: Count distinct real doctors by doctor_id in doctor_dim, which merges duplicate doctor records while keeping different doctors separate even if they share a name.
The output includes the specialty groups present in doctor_dim; no Unknown specialty group was present.

sql: SELECT count(*) AS claims_with_rejection_date FROM claim_latest WHERE rejected_on IS NOT NULL AND CAST(rejected_on AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-09-30' AND visit_date <= DATE '2026-11-30'
assumptions: Used the latest version of each claim in claim_latest.
Last quarter means July 1 through September 30, 2026, inclusive; applied to rejected_on by calendar date.
Included any claim with rejected_on set in that window, regardless of approval status; claims may be both rejected and approved.
Excluded claims with visit_date after the as-of date, November 30, 2026.
The latest loaded version is used even if loaded after the as-of date.

cases.question: What is the total approved claim amount last month for claims with a hypertension diagnosis?

output.answer: The total approved claim amount for October 2026 claims with a hypertension diagnosis was SGD 21,329.75.
sql: SELECT round(sum(cl.claim_amt_sgd), 2) AS total_approved_claim_amount_sgd FROM claim_latest cl WHERE cl.is_approved AND cl.visit_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-10-01' AND DATE '2026-10-31' AND cl.visit_date <= DATE '2026-11-30' AND cl.claim_id IN (SELECT ci.claim_id FROM claim_icd ci WHERE lower(ci.diagnosis) LIKE '%hypertension%')
assumptions: “Last month” means the complete calendar month of October 1–31, 2026, based on visit_date; future-dated visits are excluded.
Uses the latest version of each claim and approved claims only (is_approved).
Claim amount means net amount in SGD (claim_amt_sgd).
Hypertension diagnosis is identified by a diagnosis description containing “hypertension” (case-insensitive); each qualifying claim is included once even if it has multiple diagnoses.
